sights.name: Mykonos Town (Chora) lanes
sights.summary: A maze of whitewashed lanes, blue shutters and bougainvillea.

sights.name: Kato Mili windmills
sights.summary: The row of white windmills on the ridge over Little Venice.

sights.name: Little Venice
sights.summary: Captains' houses with balconies hanging right over the sea.

sights.name: Panagia Paraportiani church
sights.summary: A sculpted white church made of five chapels joined together.

sights.name: Archaeological Museum of Mykonos
sights.summary: The exhibition of the museum includes a large number of vases, ranging from the prehistoric to the late Hellenistic period (25th-1st century BC), grave statues,

sights.name: Agricultural Museum
sights.summary: A collection of traditional agricultural tools.

sights.name: Delos island
sights.travel: About 30 to 40 minutes each way by boat from the old harbor. Boats leave from about 9:00.
sights.summary: The sacred island, birthplace of Apollo, covered in ancient ruins.
